observations: Photo 0 is a professional stock image of a dark grey desktop thermal printer.
The brand 'ZEBRA' and model 'ZD421' are printed on the top control panel in photo 0.
The device features a status light bar and four control buttons (Power, Pause, Feed, Cancel).
A yellow media compartment release latch is visible on the side of the chassis.
The image contains watermarks for 'DANIESTER DAVE NIG LIMITED' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
No actual physical unit in a real-world environment is shown; no cables or accessories are visible.

claims.evidence: The model ZD421 is clearly visible on the top panel in photo 0.
Thermal transfer capability requires internal ribbon spindles which are not visible in the closed-lid stock photo.

risks.risk: The provided image is a stock photo, meaning the actual unit's existence and physical condition are unverified.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual printer with a handwritten note showing the current date and seller's name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-functional or missing unit.

risks.risk: The thermal print head may be worn or damaged, leading to white streaks or unreadable labels.
risks.proof: A photo of a self-test or configuration label printed by the actual unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a print head replacement.

risks.risk: The printer may be missing its proprietary power supply or necessary data cables.
risks.proof: A photo of the printer powered on, showing the power brick and connectivity cables.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual printer with a handwritten note of today's date to verify possession.
Video of the printer performing a self-test print to verify the print head and motor function.
Photos of the power adapter and the rear connection ports to check for physical damage.
response.reason: The model is identified as a Zebra ZD421 from the provided image. Since only a stock photo is available, the item is priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit until physical proof of the actual item is provided.
